chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Ammar ibn Marwan who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) advised me, saying: 'I advise you with the fear of Allah, and the fulfillment of trusts, and truthful narration, and good companionship to whoever you accompany, and there is no strength except with Allah.'

key_terms.أَدَاءِ الْأَمَانَةِ: Fulfillment of trusts / returning what is entrusted
key_terms.لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ: There is no strength except with Allah

ai.seo_question: What are the key ethical virtues recommended by Imam al-Sadiq for personal conduct and social interaction?
ai.summary: In this concise yet comprehensive hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) outlines the essential moral framework for a believer, linking inner piety (*Taqwa*) with social integrity through truthful speech and reliable trustworthiness. The emphasis on *Husn al-Sihabah* (good companionship) reflects the Shia scholarly view that social interactions are a primary arena for spiritual refinement, culminating in the reliance on divine strength (*La quwwata illa billah*) to maintain these virtues.
